name: dev-kit
description: Complete Claude agentic dev-kit: 11 specialized subagents, 9 skills, 4 commands, 9 hook scripts, and 6 MCP integrations for the full software development lifecycle.

context7_api_key.title: Context7 API key
context7_api_key.description: Get a free key at https://context7.com/dashboard for higher rate limits. Leave blank to use the free tier.

enable_autoformat.title: Auto-format files after edits
enable_autoformat.description: Run prettier/black/gofmt/rustfmt after Claude writes or edits a file (if installed). Override per-session with DEVKIT_DISABLE_AUTOFORMAT=1.

enable_bash_guard.title: Block destructive bash commands
enable_bash_guard.description: Block rm -rf, force-pushes to protected branches, chmod 777, and similar. Also gates the write guard. Override per-session with DEVKIT_DISABLE_BASH_GUARD=1.

enable_session_context.title: Inject project context on session start
enable_session_context.description: On SessionStart, inject git branch, recent commits, uncommitted changes, open TODOs, and recent decisions. Override per-session with DEVKIT_DISABLE_SESSION_CONTEXT=1.

openviking_base_url.title: OpenViking server URL
openviking_base_url.description: Base URL of your OpenViking server. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:1933 (standard local port). Override for a remote server.

openviking_api_key.title: OpenViking API key
openviking_api_key.description: API key for your OpenViking server.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key
brave_api_key.description: Optional. Enables web search for the researcher agent. Get a free key at brave.com/search/api.

memory_path.title: Local memory store path
memory_path.description: Path for the local knowledge graph memory store. Defaults to ~/.claude/dev-kit-memory.

memory_system.title: Active memory system
memory_system.description: Which memory system Claude should use to store and recall context. Options: openviking (recommended — auto-recall on every prompt), local-graph (mcp-knowledge-graph, lightweight JSONL store), decisions-md (no MCP, append to .claude/memory/decisions.md only).
